reviews.title: Great keyboard with incredible customizability
reviews.comment:
As my first mechanical keyboard, I was quite overwhelmed with choices of keyboards when looking to make my purchase.  I had seen several reviews of various keyboards and brands and found that Corsair had pretty consistently good reviews.  I saw they had just recently released the Vanguard 96 so I gave it a shot.  I'm glad I did!
I bought the one with linear switches, and they feel incredible to type on.  I was never convinced that I really wanted a mechanical keyboard until I felt how much better typing on linear switches feels, and now I'm not sure I could ever go back to a membrane keyboard.  The switches are smooth with no signs of wear after about four months of daily use.  I also never understood why so many keyboard reviews mentioned the sound the keys make when typing, but I can understand now.  It sounds great and isn't too loud at all.
The RGB backlighting on this keyboard is amazing.  I'm still not fully sold on kitting out my entire PC with RGB lighting, but this keyboard certainly makes me see the potential!  The colors can be adjusted keyboard-wide all the way down to a key-by-key level.  The animations are nice as well.  They keys light up evenly across the keyboard.  I haven't noticed any keys that are especially lighter or darker than the others.  They're pleasant to look at.  I think MAYBE the only complaint I have about the included keycaps would be that only the tops of them are shine-through, making the white key function markings on the front hard to see in the dark.  I think if the function symbols/marks on the front of the keys were shine-through as well, it'd make seeing them easier.  However, this is a very minor thing in my opinion.
The LCD screen is bright and vibrant.  It offers some relatively-useful options now that the keyboard has iCUE support (more on that in a moment).  I have the screen showing the currently playing Spotify song usually, but it can also display temps, fan speeds, memory usage, etc. as well as the time and date and other things.
I knowingly purchased the keyboard knowing it didn't have iCUE support at the time.  For the first three or so months, I used it with the Corsair Web Hub to keep it updated and change the settings.  It works well, though the customization is more limited when using it in the Web Hub, as you might expect.  The LCD screen has no useful widgets, instead only showing still images or animated GIFs in addition to the usual status indicators for things like CAPS Lock, polling rate, knob function, etc.
However, now Corsair has introduced iCUE support for the Vanguard 96, opening up a TON more customization options.  Being my first Corsair product, I was a little overwhelmed by just how much customizability was suddenly possible!  As this keyboard is still relatively new, there are some quirks regarding iCUE they're working on, but overall it's solid as it is.
The only real issue I've experienced with this keyboard is that key presses would fairly often register twice in quick succession, causing me to have to backspace quite a bit and fix the many double letters it would type.  I don't know if this is a common issue with mechanical keyboards, but I've read I'm not the only one having this issue with this particular keyboard.  Corsair have since introduced a "Debounce Time" setting in both Web Hub and iCUE.  I have configured mine with a debounce time of 3ms which has completely eliminated the problem.  It doesn't add any noticeable latency to keypresses when typing or gaming.  Because of this setting, I'm now completely happy with the purchase!
The included wrist rest feels absolutely amazing!  It's made of a soft, smooth material with ample padding underneath.  It attaches magnetically to the front of the keyboard, so it's extremely easy to remove when cleaning it.  I wish all keyboard wrist rests felt this good!
Overall, I love this keyboard.  I was able to get it on sale which made it an even better deal in my opinion.  After using standard-layout membrane keyboards my entire life, I'm still getting used to the 96% layout of the Corsair Vanguard 96, but it's a solid keyboard and I don't think I could ever go back to membranes!
reviews.author: Cody F.

reviews.title: Yes, it's Good as It Looks!
reviews.comment:
I’ve used a lot of mechanical keyboards over the years, and this one honestly feels like it’s trying to do everything and somehow pulls most of it off.
The first thing you notice is how fast and smooth it feels. The linear switches are really clean and consistent, and combined with the 8000Hz polling rate, everything just feels instant. Whether I’m gaming or just typing normally, there’s no lag or hesitation. It’s one of those keyboards that feels “snappy” in a really satisfying way. I got the plasma switches and it sounds so good!! If you are an ASMR lover - this will scratch that itch.
reviews.author: Kris
